summary: Pre-market brief: composite risk 50.6, the caution band, regime goldilocks and confidence 0.9175. The composite added only 0.21 while the discount-rate block rolled to a 2026-09-28 vintage that set new cycle extremes: the ten-year at 5.24 and the real rate at 2.90, both in the 100.0th percentile, with the front end leading as the two-year rose 0.11 to 4.92. The genuinely new ingredient is the policy path - FedWatch implies 3.747 with action cut against an effective fed funds rate of 3.88, the first easing pricing in this sample. Cross-asset confirmation worsened to 0.75 with 6 of the 8 production signals triggered. The last completed US session split, 12 of 22 sectors and themes higher, led by semiconductor equipment at 3.2581 while memory lagged at -0.4223; the tracked A-share panel closed all 11 names lower into the CN holiday, worst 002156.sz at -5.7323. Tonight's PCE release, the methodology revision attached to it, and the Hormuz shipping incidents are the immediate overnight inputs.

top_risk_drivers.claim: The discount-rate constraint set new cycle extremes on a 2026-09-28 vintage: the ten-year at 5.24 and the real rate at 2.90 both sit in the 100.0th percentile with risk scores of 100.0, and macro is the heaviest block as well as the only block trending higher, at 70.63.

The policy path flipped to easing pricing: FedWatch implies 3.747 with action cut against an effective fed funds rate of 3.88, yet the two-year still rose 0.11 to 4.92, so the front end and the policy path now point in opposite directions.

The curve bear-flattened: the ten-year at 5.24 against the two-year at 4.92 leaves the 10Y/2Y spread at 0.32, down from 0.36 and in the 60.35th percentile, so the long end is not the only part of the curve repricing.
Cross-asset confirmation worsened to 0.75, with 6 of the 8 production signals triggered: dollar strength at 120.33, real-rate pressure at 2.90 and small-cap underperformance at -9.47.

Equity structure stayed thin: the new-highs ratio is 0.0064 with 1 qualifying name against new lows at 0.1154, breadth above the 200-day average is 0.5484 or 85 of 155 names, and semis relative is -13.7767.

supporting_signals.claim: Credit has stopped confirming stress: HY OAS at 3.02 sits in the 50.19th percentile and IG OAS at 0.83 in the 46.56th, so the liquidity and credit block is flat at 50.18 rather than deteriorating.
The volatility dimension is still scoring low: the VIX at 16.07 sits in the 32.94th percentile and realized volatility is 11.0633 with a risk score of 14.25, leaving the block at 24.22.

The tracked A-share panel closed all 11 names lower into the CN holiday, led by 002156.sz at -5.7323 and 688008.sh at -4.8401, against the last completed US session where semiconductor equipment rose 3.2581.

AI hardware leadership is real but narrow and confined to the equipment layer: semiconductor equipment 3.2581, networking 1.9066 and data centers 1.0601 advanced while memory fell 0.4223 and quantum computing 0.9388.
Diversion is showing up on both sides: the dollar at 120.33 is above the 105 threshold while gold added 0.9977, so two hedges are being bought at once.

contradicting_signals.claim: The front end and the policy path disagree: the two-year rose 0.11 to 4.92 while FedWatch moved to an easing bias at 3.747 against an effective fed funds rate of 3.88.

The volatility observation is stale-dated: the VIX at 16.07 carries a 2026-09-28 observation while the fact layer was generated 2026-09-30, so the block at 24.22 may understate the most recent sessions.
Credit widening to HY OAS 3.02 from 2.93 is the only deterioration in the layer, but at the 50.19th percentile it reads as normalisation rather than stress.
2 of the 8 production cross-asset signals stayed untriggered, so confirmation is 0.75 rather than complete.
Realized volatility at 11.0633 carries a risk score of 14.25, far below the VIX at 16.07, so the volatility block is split between a calm and an elevated reading.

what_changed_today: The composite rose 0.21 to 50.6, a high for the sample, with the caution band and the goldilocks regime both unchanged.
The rates block rolled to a 2026-09-28 observation: the ten-year at 5.24 from 5.17, the two-year at 4.92 from 4.81 and the real rate at 2.90 from 2.83, flattening the curve to 0.32 from 0.36.
The policy path flipped from hike pricing to easing pricing: FedWatch implies 3.747 with action cut against an effective fed funds rate of 3.88.
Cross-asset confirmation worsened to 0.75, with 6 of the 8 production signals triggered.
Breakevens advanced with the nominal move: the 5-year/5-year forward at 2.36 from 2.35 and the ten-year breakeven at 2.35 from 2.34.
Credit widened: HY OAS to 3.02 from 2.93 and IG OAS to 0.83 from 0.81, the only credit deterioration in the layer.
The last completed US session split, 12 of 22 sectors and themes higher, led by semiconductor equipment at 3.2581 while memory lagged at -0.4223.
The tracked A-share panel closed all 11 names lower, led by 002156.sz at -5.7323 and 688008.sh at -4.8401.
The volatility block held at 24.22 and the VIX observation did not advance beyond the 2026-09-28 close at 16.07.
watch_next: The Personal Income and Outlays release at 2026-09-30T12:30Z carries the Fed's preferred inflation measure and a methodology revision, so the level may be flattered relative to the underlying trend.
The Gross Domestic Product print at the same timestamp and the 2026-10-02 Employment Situation complete the week's high-importance macro tests, with payrolls at 162.0 on a 2026-08 vintage.
Whether the easing-priced policy path survives the data: the two-year and FedWatch now disagree, and a reversal would remove the marginal support the front end has been pricing.
Whether the volatility vintage advances past the 2026-09-28 observation, since the current VIX of 16.07 is dated 2 days before the fact layer.

Whether the A-share panel's unanimous decline transmits into the US AI hardware complex or stays a local de-rating: XSHG is closed 2026-10-01 through 2026-10-06, so the CN leg cannot confirm for a week.
NKE earnings on 2026-10-01 and the Hormuz shipping incidents: whether the energy channel reprices before the PCE print lands.

bull_case.title: Bull case: the discount-rate extreme is near its peak
points: Policy pricing has already flipped to easing: FedWatch implies 3.747 with action cut against an effective fed funds rate of 3.88.
Credit is not confirming stress: HY OAS at 3.02 in the 50.19th percentile and IG OAS at 0.83 in the 46.56th.
Realized volatility at 11.0633 scores only 14.25, three-month momentum is positive at 2.3341, and the price sits 6.2499 above its 200-day average.

base_case.title: Base case: strains persist without a break
points: The ten-year at 5.24 and the real rate at 2.90 both sit in the 100.0th percentile and macro is the heaviest block at 70.63 with a rising trend.
Breadth above the 200-day average is 0.5484 with the new-highs ratio at 0.0064 against new lows at 0.1154.

points: The front end is still rising into an easing-priced path: the two-year at 4.92 against a 0.32 curve, so further front-end pressure flattens it further.
The tracked A-share panel closed all 11 names lower, worst 002156.sz at -5.7323, and XSHG is shut from 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-06.
